name: shopify-storefront
description: Three Shopify skills: campaign-launcher plans a campaign from one sentence or its materials (one-line plan kept in one artifact, calendar invite), readies the website on the staging theme, drafts email, SMS and ads as stubs, and sets Launch and Stop reminders (it never publishes on its own); campaign-page generates a campaign landing page template whose sections swap with one switch in the theme editor or by asking Claude; theme-editor matches the theme's colours (and fonts if asked) to the style guide. Both work through the Shopify connector or CLI and read BRAND.md, BRAND-VOICE.md and THEME-SPECIFICS.md.
